name: fleet-refresh-task-seeding
title: Seed fleet-refresh consumer tasks with real PRD and context entries
description: sd-fleet-refresh checkout-validation creates the dedicated consumer Trellis task by hand from prose in .agents/skills/sd-fleet-refresh/SKILL.md, and four defects recur per consumer PR, each surfacing at focused-candidate or later instead of at the stage that creates the task. (1) task.json base_branch is stamped as the refresh branch: every consumer checked carries a vendored task_store.py whose create writes "base_branch": current_branch unconditionally (line 325 in rwbp-coordinator, hoa-manager, loadsmith; zero occurrences of resolve_default_branch), while this pack's own checkout carries the later revision that resolves origin/HEAD first (task_store.py:333-346, issue #399 item 1) - so the defect is invisible from the source tree and reproducible in the fleet, and SKILL.md's branch-then-task ordering triggers it. The pack's review preflight rejects it under the root-task rule that base_branch must equal the repository default branch. (2) An empty task.json description reaches focused-candidate, even though SKILL.md already requires asserting a non-empty description at checkout-validation; the guard is prose with no mechanical enforcement. (3) prd.md ships TBD requirements and empty acceptance criteria and implement.jsonl/check.jsonl ship _example scaffold rows, which the ready gate in .trellis/workflow.md rejects. (4) implement.jsonl/check.jsonl cite paths under the seeded task's own directory, which the review preflight allows because .trellis/tasks/**/research/** is an allowed root; task.py archive then moves the directory and the pointer dangles in the merged tree, after the completion bundle is already published (observed on platypeeps/hoa-manager PR 247, 2026-08-13). First observed on platypeeps/rwbp-coordinator PR 222 during campaign refresh-0.71.2-20260813T002259Z, where defects 1-3 were fixed by hand; defect 4 was not observed until PR 247, after that campaign. Make checkout-validation set base_branch explicitly via task.py set-base-branch immediately after create (not create --base-branch, which the skewed consumers reject as an unrecognized argument since that flag ships with the same revision that fixes the defect), and check the seeded task mechanically by sharing the preflight's rules rather than restating them.
